# reselling_load_balancer_target (Resource)

A target of a load balancer: a rootserver of its VPC (`server`), every server of the VPC carrying a label (`label`), or an address in the VPC (`ip`). Import with `load_balancer_id/target_id`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Every server of the VPC with the label "web".
resource "reselling_load_balancer_target" "web" {
  load_balancer_id = reselling_load_balancer.web.id
  type             = "label"
  label            = "web"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `load_balancer_id` (String)
- `type` (String) `server`, `label` or `ip`.

### Optional

- `ip_address` (String) For type `ip`.
- `label` (String) For type `label`.
- `port` (Number) Overrides the target port of the services.
- `rootserver_id` (String) For type `server`.
- `weight` (Number) Weight 1-256 (default 100).

### Read-Only

- `health` (String) Health summary reported by the load balancer.
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `members` (List of String) Resolved addresses.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import reselling_load_balancer_target.web <load_balancer_id>/<target_id>
```
